changelog:
Renewed the shared CloudStream dialog styling, compact spacing, fonts and Material icon geometry.
Restored supported controls and search with owner-safe navigation and lifecycle cleanup.
Hardened player action ownership, subtitle callbacks, system bars and native dialog fit.
Fixed a packaged-host Compose pointer ABI crash.
Fixed player-settings option summaries (ListPreference crash).
The CSM settings row reports the running version again.
The function registry no longer advertises features that have no runtime consumer.
Show Zoom Buttons is implemented again: zoom +/- controls in the player control bar.
The CSM menu now opens and closes with CloudStream's own settings animation.
The CSM settings page is full width on Android TV.
message: Settings parity, player fixes and TV layout
